title: 小小英文新鲜事 - 1107 | 胖老鹰飞不动、青少年奥运、蓝色血液
description:
🎧 本期音频为全英文，适合有一定英语基础的小朋友。

👧 今天 Mia 和 Lina 聊了三个新鲜事：

🦅 美国一只老鹰吃太多邻居家的鸡，胖到飞不起来，只好先减肥！
🏅 非洲第一次办奥运赛事：达喀尔青少年奥运会开幕，两千七百名青少年选手参赛！
🩸 章鱼流的是蓝色的血，南极冰鱼流的竟是白色的血！

📖 Word of the day: feast（大餐）

🎮 小挑战：今晚吃饭时给家人讲讲胖老鹰的故事，教他们今天的单词 feast，再像老鹰一样扇三下翅膀！

---
🇬🇧 In today's episode:

🦅 A hawk in Virginia ate so many of her neighbor's chickens that she got too fat to fly!
🏅 The Youth Olympic Games opened in Dakar, Senegal — the first Olympic event ever held in Africa!
🩸 Octopuses bleed blue, and a fish in Antarctica bleeds white!

📖 Word of the day: feast

🎮 Tiny challenge: tonight at dinner, tell your family the story of the too-fat hawk, teach them the word feast, and flap your arms three times like a hawk warming up to fly!

📝 生词本 Words to learn

1. feast（大餐）
a big, yummy meal with lots of food
例：We had a big feast on my birthday!（我生日那天吃了一顿大餐！）

2. hawk（老鹰）
a bird that hunts other animals
例：The hawk is too full to fly!（这只老鹰吃得太饱，飞不起来了！）

3. athlete（运动员）
a person who plays sports and competes
例：The young athletes are at the Olympics!（年轻运动员们正在参加奥运会！）

4. copper（铜）
a reddish-brown metal, like the metal in a penny
例：Copper makes the octopus blood blue!（铜让章鱼的血变成了蓝色！）
